cases.prompt: Reconstruct a draft PNS from this valid bpmn-beta source.
expectations: Preserves source element IDs and explicit flows.
Includes open questions for unsupported narrative evidence.
Separates lane-derived ownership from confirmed RACI accountability.
cases.failure_consequence: Diagram structure is mistaken for an elicited process record.

cases.prompt: Turn this diagram into a complete approved PNS with KPIs, controls, and accountable owners.
expectations: Does not claim complete or approved recovery.
Leaves unsupported fields explicit and unrecoverable.
Routes the result to fidelity assessment and elicitation.
cases.failure_consequence: The agent fabricates governance or measurement facts.

cases.prompt: Reverse this malformed source or PNG into authoritative process documentation.
expectations: Reports parse errors or blocks unsupported image input.
Does not treat OCR or visual guesses as parsed bpmn-beta facts.
Requests a valid textual source or human confirmation.
cases.failure_consequence: Untrusted or malformed content becomes authoritative process data.

holdout.note: No protected holdout is packaged yet; no release-quality performance claim is permitted.
